general.notes: Product is a BiDi pair: SO-SFP-10GE-BX80D-4955 (Tx 1480–1500 nm / Rx 1540–1560 nm, nominal 1490/1550 nm) and SO-SFP-10GE-BX80D-5549 (Tx 1540–1560 nm / Rx 1480–1500 nm, nominal 1550/1490 nm). Power budget 10–22 dB. Dispersion penalty max 3 dB (no paired penalized value or operating condition in table). Transmitter output power and receiver min/overload are average power. Receiver min input and overload measured @ 10.3 Gbps, BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹², PRBS 2³¹-1, back-to-back. Power consumption stated as < 2.0 W. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Protocol support includes 10GbE-LAN, 10GbE-WAN, CPRI Opt, 7, 8. IEEE 802.3ae 10GBASE-ER/EW referenced for bridgeable distance at 1550 nm only.
